qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the assembly of upper and lower sections of the control unit housing?
Which engine types use the assembly of upper and lower sections specification?
What torque value is specified for the center section to body connection?
Which engine variants require the center section to body torque specification?
What is the torque specification for the control unit holder in E box?
What torque value is required for the control unit box cover?
Which engine variants use the control unit box cover torque specification?
What is the lowest torque specification shown in the control unit housing section?
qa_pairs.answer: 3 Nm (ft. lbs.) for the center section to body

qa_pairs.question: How many different torque specifications are listed for the control unit housing components?
qa_pairs.answer: 4 different torque specifications: 5 Nm, 3 Nm, 5 Nm, and 4.4 Nm
